axioms.name: Experimental.P06_12.upstream_beta_four_moments_integrable
axioms.meaning: Polynomial moments of the explicit §6.12 beta-four weight are integrable on the positive half-line; independent of sign-flipped Gram positivity or rational approximation.

typed_coverage: Explicit §6.12 analytic weight, actual real integral entries, and a positive reference-root equation. Integrability is isolated without assuming Gram positivity, an effective rational approximation, or valuation preservation.
missing_domain_interfaces: The beta rational functional and its equality to these integrals; beta derivative diagonalization; a quantitative spectral margin and continuity modulus; an effective rational selection; all q-adic models.
repair_gates: Resolve the manuscript’s missing labels and its incompatible integer-square/odd-square parameter conventions.
Prove the reference Gram margin and an effective perturbation bound before constructing r_K.
The q-adic side requires the actual nonzero residue exclusions and both stated prime regimes; do not assume the desired determinant valuation.
validation: Static source review only; no Lean process, build or axiom audit run.
